Chinese Hackers Impersonated AI Experts to Target US Policy

Chinese hackers posed as artificial intelligence experts to target individuals involved in US policy-making, according to reports. The operation involved deception, including the use of lies and betrayal, to gain access and gather information. The Federal Reserve was among the entities targeted.
